Since Bun 1.4.4, `sql.array(values)` without a type isn't cast to `JSON[]`. PostgreSQL picks the type from the query.

`--fix-suggestions` passes `"JSON"`.

`bun lint --upgrade` runs this rule. See [Upgrade Bun](/lint#upgrade-bun).

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. To turn it on:

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"bun/sql-require-array-type" = "error" # or "warn"
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}
```ts
import { sql } from "bun";

await sql`INSERT INTO events (payloads) VALUES (${sql.array(payloads)})`;
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```ts
import { sql } from "bun";

await sql`INSERT INTO events (payloads) VALUES (${sql.array(payloads, "JSON")})`;
```
